tested_on: Greenbone Community Containers 22.7 (the maintainer's playground and docker host): GMP over TLS, login as an Observer user, a 'Full and fast' scan of one host, 5 real findings read (critical, medium, low) with port, score, solution and time; the filter syntax that gvmd accepts; paging and duplicate handling against a fake gvmd replaying the recorded answers
Greenbone Community 22.7 on the maintainer's docker host: an Observer user that is (and is not) an observer of the scan tasks; findings read through that user
reviews.notes: Written and lab-tested on 2026-10-18 with the assistant Claude against a real Greenbone and confirmed by the maintainer. Read-only (get_version, get_tasks, get_results): it never starts or changes a scan. Not seen on the real scanner: results with CVE references (they follow the protocol documentation), several tasks scanning one host and very large result sets.
